correctness.rationale: A complete direct proof separates forced terminal-terminal edges, optional nonterminal-nonterminal edges and disjoint terminal-incidence stars. Terminal diameter <=2 makes the surviving-neighbor clique constraint both necessary and sufficient. Maximization and maximality of local cliques prove the minimum/inclusion-minimal characterizations. Exact coefficient formula, universal clique-polynomial construction, discriminant -108, multipartite factorization, log-concavity and star rigidity are algebraically derived. Independent BFS enumerators agree on 17,804 arbitrary graph-terminal and 1,905 multipartite cases; finite experiments only corroborate the unrestricted proof.
